title: Operons and the Organization of Prokaryotic Genes
method: Whitespace-delimited visible teaching paragraph words excluding diagrams, tables, practice, references and UI; total article includes headings, practice, captions and references but excludes SVG and buttons.
comparator: 2.B.10 recorded 9074 narrative words, 21 sections; 2.B.09 10619 words, 22 sections. Narrower 2.C.02 remit receives 14 theory sections (373–668 narrative words each), with complete structural maps, experiments, exceptions and quantitative reasoning; avoids detailed Unit 3.D attenuation/regulatory duplication.
scientific_checks: Official merged CSIR LS&BT Unit 2.C page 3, separate LS page 2, archived MP SET 2024 page 2 visually inspected. Jacob–Monod 1961, Cooper and Alberts, OpenStax, WormBook, NCBI Gene and lac operator references consulted. Draft critically reviewed and revised: operator arrows, graph interpretation, specific sources, numerical wording, prerequisite links. Checked strand orientation, cis/trans, lacZYA/lacI, trpEDCBA/trpR/trpL, TrpD/TrpC, polarity, nested transcripts, RNA continuity, eukaryotic exceptions, numerical solutions and distractors. Original figures/questions; hypothetical data identified. No independent human reviewer.
limitations: Static source QA and self-review; no independent human review or interactive browser/device testing. Current MPPSC-hosted syllabus not independently verified; archived SET 2024 used. Pages verification pending.
